ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account flag — driver did press "I'm Here" while inside the pickup radius, so the mis-timed cancellation is a procedural error, not button abuse.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver states he waited more than 3 minutes, but the GPS trace shows him within 200 m of the pickup point for only ~110 s (14:13:00 → 14:14:50) before cancelling; system records override the statement. NS-1(iii) is not met.

'Waited more than 3 min, cancelling' at 14:14:40 is contradicted by the 5 s GPS samples (still approaching at 26.9 km/h at 14:12:30, first on-location sample 14:13:00) — waiting time at the pickup point was under 3 minutes.
